project_type: CDK infrastructure project (TypeScript) + Python agent, deploying Strands AI agents to AWS Bedrock AgentCore Runtime
build_system: npm for CDK, pip for agent. CDK uses tsc for TypeScript compilation.
test_framework: Currently Jest with ts-jest transpiler and snapshot testing. Migrating to Vitest.
verification_instructions: 1. cd cdk && npm install. 2. npm run build (TypeScript type check). 3. npm test (run tests). 4. npm run check (lint:ci + format:ci). 5. Verify snapshot is regenerated by Vitest.
snapshot_or_generated_files: cdk/test/__snapshots__/cdk.test.ts.snap - Jest snapshot file. Vitest generates snapshots in the same location but with a different header comment. Old Jest snapshot must be deleted and Vitest will regenerate.
setup_instructions: cd cdk && nvm use 24 && npm install
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. Node.js 24 available via nvm. No Docker daemon needed for this task.
contribution_requirements: Conventional commits. Run npm run build && npm test && npm run lint before submitting. CONTRIBUTING.md references Jest but this PR is specifically migrating away from it.
key_patterns: Prettier: singleQuote, no semi, es5 trailing commas, 100 printWidth. ESLint: typescript-eslint with type-checked rules + prettier integration. tsconfig: NodeNext module/moduleResolution, ES2023 target, strict mode. Tests use CDK assertions (Template, Match from aws-cdk-lib/assertions). Snapshot test normalizes container hash before snapshotting.
directory_structure: cdk/ - CDK infrastructure (bin/, lib/, test/, config files). agent/ - Python agent. .github/workflows/ - CI. .kiro/steering/ - AI guidance docs.
